"""R1Pro BEHAVIOR-1K laying_tile_floors episode driver."""
import os, sys, json, time
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

print('Connecting to simulator...', flush=True)
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
print(json.dumps(spec, indent=2), flush=True)

def save_obs(obs, tag='obs'):
    os.makedirs('/app/output/observations', exist_ok=True)
    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
        name = cam.split(':')[1].replace('_link','').replace('Camera','cam')
        Image.fromarray(im).save(f'/app/output/observations/{tag}_{name}.jpg')
    with open(f'/app/output/observations/{tag}_meta.json','w') as f:
        json.dump(obs.meta, f, indent=2)
    return obs

def observe(tag='obs'):
    o = r.get_obs()
    save_obs(o, tag)
    print('meta:', json.dumps(o.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
    return o

def submit(action_type, actions, **kwargs):
    res = r.submit(action_type, actions, **kwargs)
    res.save('/app/output/last_result')
    print('result meta:', json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
    return res

    os.makedirs('/app/output/observations', exist_ok=True)

        name = cam.split(':')[1].replace('_link','').replace('Camera','cam')
